content:
I am really not a fan of ecogs in d-tide either. I have only ever used them early game in events and early in train mode for progression. Outside of that I have avoided using them entirely as it doesn't feel good to win with them and definitely fear they will become mandatory to use in at least some d-tide stages.

I feel like this D-tide rework is almost entirely aimed at the minority of players getting 400 or 425 in d-tide because the AA and recent buffs made the game easier for the Whales/dolphins and longtime players. I usually only aim for 375 but pushed to 390 just to see how many players are actually on the leaderboard.
375 - Rank 2700, 380 - Rank 2200 ,385 - Rank 2000, 390 - Rank 1800
Based on those ranks the vast majority of players are barely going to interact with the new d-tide difficulties beyond trying to match the rewards they are already getting.
